query: What medical expenses related to accidents are included under the MediShield Life Scheme?
reference_answer: Dental work is covered under the MediShield Life Scheme only if required due to accidental injuries.
context:
[Document 1]
The deductible under MediShield Life ranges from $2,000 to $4,500, depending on the claimant's age and choice of ward class.

[Document 2]
Dental work is covered under the MediShield Life Scheme only if required due to accidental injuries.

[Document 3]
A summary of the key features of the MediShield Life Scheme can be found in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet.

[Document 4]
Older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 annually from 2021 to 2025, which can be used to pay MediShield Life premiums.

[Document 5]
The claimable amount is $1,000 and it is less than the deductible of $2,000, so there is no payout from MediShield Life.
answer: Under MediShield Life, medical expenses for accidents include dental work due to accidental injuries, but not all medical expenses. The scheme covers $1,000 up to a $2,000 deductible, meaning if costs are less than the deductible, no payout occurs. [Document 2] & [Document 4]
